venue: A private dining room, West Village
includes: Four courses from one kitchen, cooked that day
A welcome pour, and a paired glass with each course
Coffee, a parting sweet, and the recipe card to take home

courses.title: To begin
courses.name: Embered leeks
courses.description: Young leeks cooked in the dying coals, brown butter, toasted hazelnut, a sharpness of cider vinegar.
courses.pairing: A dry sparkling from the Finger Lakes

courses.title: The pasta
courses.name: Chestnut agnolotti
courses.description: Hand-folded agnolotti of chestnut and ricotta, crisped sage, a ladle of parmesan broth at the table.
courses.pairing: Savagnin from the Jura, faintly oxidative

courses.title: The fire
courses.name: Duck over the coals
courses.description: Dry-aged duck rested over embers, quince glaze, black garlic, bitter leaves dressed while you watch.

courses.title: To finish
courses.name: Burnt-honey custard
courses.description: A set custard of burnt honey, bay-poached pear, buckwheat shortbread still warm from the oven.
courses.pairing: A small glass of Tokaji — or chamomile from the pot
